reference.intro: Open-licence gross and histological references for polycystic kidney disease, xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis, acute cellular rejection and BK polyomavirus nephropathy.

groups.heading: Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD)
points: Massively enlarged kidneys diffusely replaced by innumerable variably sized fluid- or haemorrhage-filled cysts
Cysts lined by flattened to cuboidal epithelium with compressed, sclerotic intervening parenchyma and occasional papillary epithelial hyperplasia
Always sample any thickened cyst wall or solid/haemorrhagic nodule to exclude incidental RCC

images.caption: ADPKD — massively enlarged native kidney diffusely replaced by innumerable cortical and medullary cysts (gross).
Polycystic kidney disease — multiple dilated cysts lined by bland cuboidal-to-flattened epithelium with intervening fibrotic parenchyma (H&E).

groups.heading: Xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis (XGP)
points: Sheets of lipid-laden foamy macrophages (CD68+), lymphocytes, plasma cells and multinucleated giant cells replacing parenchyma
Classic clinical and radiological mimic of renal cell carcinoma (negative for PAX8/RCC/CK; strongly CD68+)

images.caption: Xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis — dense sheets of CD68-positive foamy histiocytes and giant cells.

groups.heading: Renal allograft rejection (Banff 2022) & BK polyomavirus
points: Active TCMR: interstitial mononuclear inflammation (i), tubulitis (t) and/or intimal arteritis (v); Chronic active TCMR adds chronic allograft arteriopathy (cv) and inflammation in areas of IFTA (i-IFTA)
Active/Chronic active ABMR: microvascular inflammation (g + ptc >= 2), transplant glomerulopathy (cg > 0), and linear peritubular capillary C4d
BK polyomavirus nephropathy: basophilic intranuclear ground-glass viral inclusions in tubular epithelium confirmed by SV40 IHC

images.caption: Acute cellular rejection in renal allograft — dense interstitial lymphocytic infiltrate with tubulitis (H&E).
images.credit: Dept of Pathology, Calicut Medical College (Wikimedia Commons)

images.caption: BK polyomavirus — enlarged tubular epithelial nuclei with ground-glass basophilic intranuclear viral inclusions.

reference.title: Failed renal allograft reference gallery (Banff 2022)
reference.intro: Key morphological patterns of renal allograft failure: T-cell-mediated rejection, antibody-mediated rejection, chronic allograft arteriopathy and BK polyomavirus nephropathy.

groups.heading: T-cell-mediated & antibody-mediated rejection (Banff 2022)
points: TCMR: tubulitis (t), interstitial inflammation (i), intimal arteritis (v), chronic allograft arteriopathy (cv) with neointimal lymphocytes/foam cells
ABMR: glomerulitis (g), peritubular capillaritis (ptc), double contours / transplant glomerulopathy (cg), peritubular capillary C4d

images.caption: Renal allograft acute cellular rejection — dense interstitial mononuclear infiltrate with tubulitis (H&E).
images.credit: Dept of Pathology, Calicut Medical College (Wikimedia Commons)

groups.heading: BK polyomavirus nephropathy
points: Intranuclear basophilic ground-glass viral inclusions in tubular epithelial cells with tubulointerstitial nephritis
Confirm with SV40 (simian virus 40) large T-antigen immunohistochemistry

images.caption: Polyomavirus — enlarged nuclei with homogeneous basophilic ground-glass intranuclear inclusions.

fields.label: Allograft / Banff 2022 histological features
options: Chronic allograft arteriopathy (cv) with intimal fibrosis
Severe interstitial fibrosis and tubular atrophy (IFTA, ci3/ct3)

fields.label: Parenchymal & vascular changes
options: Marked interstitial fibrosis and tubular atrophy (IFTA)
Papillary epithelial hyperplasia in cyst walls

options: Acquired cystic disease-associated RCC (use Kidney Ca synoptic)

snippets.label: ADPKD — no malignancy note
snippets.text: Extensive sampling of thickened cyst walls and solid areas shows no evidence of renal cell carcinoma.

snippets.label: Banff 2022 DSA / clinical correlation
snippets.text: Correlation with donor-specific HLA antibody (DSA) testing, immunosuppression history and pre-explant clinical findings is recommended in accordance with the Banff 2022 classification.

snippets.label: Incidental RCC synoptic reminder
snippets.text: An incidental renal cell carcinoma is identified; formal synoptic staging should be completed using the Kidney carcinoma resection template.
